text:
To find the total time to clean one-half of the rooms:

1. Calculate one-half of the rooms:
   $90 \div 2 = 45\text{ rooms}$

2. Calculate the total time in minutes:
   $45\text{ rooms} \times 20\text{ minutes/room} = 900\text{ minutes}$

3. Convert minutes to hours:
   $900\text{ minutes} \div 60\text{ minutes/hour} = 15\text{ hours}$

ANSWER: 15
